parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1851" y="574" width="269" height="16" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c360" value="<b>What the clock says</b><br>• Chain: build 26 → gate 1 31 → round 36 → gate 2 38 → landing 8 min. Five relays through the orchestrator: 8 min in all (this was a one-ticket batch, nothing queued).<br>• Gate 1: 31 min active, 9 min inside tool calls, 22 min of model time deciding what to attack and writing 8 probe specs (a → h).<br>• Gate 2: 38 min active, 24 min inside tool calls, of which 18.8 min waiting on background sweeps; 15 min of model time. It re-ran gate 1's exhaustive probes at the new head and again at the gated sha as a positive control, then six new attacks the dispatch named (the round replaced the matching search in matchPart).<br>• The gate agent was idle 39 min between gate 1's return and the wake: the round's duration. Idle costs no tokens, but each of gate 2's 73 turns re-read ~392k cached tokens (gate 1: ~171k per turn) because a wake carries gate 1's whole transcript.<br>• Every poll on a background sweep is a turn, and every turn re-reads everything: the 600 s cap turned one 15-minute sweep into three turns." style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;rounded=1;spacing=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="604" width="2042" height="106" as="geometry"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
svg.text: lg-40, 2026-10-18 — one ticket's clock, from the three agent transcripts

Every block is one tool call (width = how long the harness waited for it) or the model's gap between calls. Red triangles are messages from the orchestrator (dispatch, round, wake). Hover a block in a browser for the command. Times are UTC.

svg.text: 04:28:24 full ledger suite + npm run check
04:29:30 writes run-probes.sh + probe i, j; second worktree
04:31:07 waits on probe c / d re-run at the new head (3.2 + 0.7 min)
04:36:25 probe k, mutate2.mjs, run-mutants.sh: positive control + 9 mutants
04:40:41 probe m; launches probe j at the new head AND at the gated sha
04:41:27 waits 10 min (600 s cap) then 4.7 min more: 505,120-case sweep, twice
full project suite / npm run check
write or run a probe / mutation
idle: the agent exists but nothing is sent to it
• Chain: build 26 → gate 1 31 → round 36 → gate 2 38 → landing 8 min. Five relays through the orchestrator: 8 min in all (this was a one-ticket batch, nothing queued).
• Gate 1: 31 min active, 9 min inside tool calls, 22 min of model time deciding what to attack and writing 8 probe specs (a → h).

• Gate 2: 38 min active, 24 min inside tool calls, of which 18.8 min waiting on background sweeps; 15 min of model time. It re-ran gate 1's exhaustive probes at the new head and again at the gated sha as a positive control, then six new attacks the dispatch named (the round replaced the matching search in matchPart).

• The gate agent was idle 39 min between gate 1's return and the wake: the round's duration. Idle costs no tokens, but each of gate 2's 73 turns re-read ~392k cached tokens (gate 1: ~171k per turn) because a wake carries gate 1's whole transcript.
• Every poll on a background sweep is a turn, and every turn re-reads everything: the 600 s cap turned one 15-minute sweep into three turns.
